groups.name: Pokémon toys & cards
groups.description: Every Pokémon Happy Meal comes with one mini box toy and two TCG promo cards. The 15 mini boxes, one Pokémon each, double as bag charms. Seven of the 15 cards are holo foils, including Pikachu, Mimikyu and Jirachi.
